title: OAuth callback route has no direct tests
reasoning: This route sits on auth, user input, serialization, and an external OAuth exchange boundary, but there are no linked tests and no repository tests matching /newsletters/oauth/callback. That leaves important behavior unpinned: auth enforcement, body validation, success response shape, and error-to-400 mapping when token exchange fails.
recommendation: Add focused route tests using FastAPI TestClient and a monkeypatched NewsletterService to cover successful exchange, exchange failure mapped to 400, missing auth when auth is enabled, and invalid request body handling.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: Existing newsletter tests exercise NewsletterService parsing/fetching behavior only; they do not call the FastAPI POST /oauth/callback endpoint.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create tests/test_newsletter_api.py with TestClient coverage for POST /api/newsletters/oauth/callback success and failure paths while stubbing NewsletterService.exchange_code_with_callback.
minimumFixScope: Add route-level pytest coverage for app/api/newsletters.py.
